sys_script_fix.description: Idempotent remediation for the already-installed SafeTrace demo data. Calls bfd_DemoDataRepair.repairAll(), which (1) stamps unique 7-digit padded display numbers on records whose number column is NULL — CUST on bfd_customer_profile.customer_number, TXN on bfd_transaction.transaction_reference, CASE on bfd_fraud_dispute_case.case_number and TASK on bfd_case_task.number, ordered by sys_created_on and continuing the existing sequence — and (2) backfills bfd_case_metric_snapshot for every resolved or closed case that has no snapshot row. Updates run with setWorkflow(false) and autoSysFields(false) so triage/routing business rules do not re-fire and audit stamps are untouched. Safe to run repeatedly: existing numbers are never changed and snapshots are never double-inserted.
sys_script_fix.name: BFD - Repair demo data and metrics
